items.name: Awesome Decomp Games
items.description: A rated, automatically refreshed discovery index for game decompilations, static recompilations, reverse-engineered projects, source ports, engine remakes, disassemblies, and browser ports. Use it to find leads, then confirm every project directly from its maintainer repository or official site.
items.source_evidence: The maintainer README checked 2026-10-16 lists 2,118 projects covering 1,829 games and links to the searchable website and source data. GitHub reported the repository as active (not archived), with a latest commit on 2026-10-16 and 947 stars at review time. This catalog records the index as a discovery resource only; its dataset is not imported or treated as primary evidence for any project.
